Verify Now Blog > How to Get $29 PCB Assembly and Meet the Requirements How to Get $29 PCB Assembly and Meet the Requirements by: Mila Oct 21,2026 <dynamic-value> <dynamic-value> Posted in PCB Assembly PCBWay's $29 PCB assembly offer provides a special assembly service price for eligible PCB prototypes. It is designed for relatively simple projects with limited assembly requirements. Not every PCB assembly project qualifies for this offer. Your project must meet the technical requirements listed below, and the promotion is subject to customer eligibility and usage limits. $29 PCB Assembly Requirements To qualify for the $29 PCB assembly offer, your project must meet all of the following requirements: Component Sourcing: All components must be supplied by PCBWay. PCB Type: Only rigid PCBs are eligible. Flex PCBs and rigid-flex PCBs are not supported by this offer. Assembly Quantity: No more than 20 boards per order. Components per Board: Each board can have a maximum of 200 components. Total Component Quantity: The total number of components across the order cannot exceed 600. Unique Component Types: The project can include no more than 100 different component types. Through-Hole Solder Joints: The total number of through-hole solder joints cannot exceed 100. All limits are inclusive. For example, an order for exactly 20 boards or a project with exactly 100 different component types can qualify, provided that all other requirements are also met. Important: Meeting these technical requirements does not automatically guarantee the promotional price. Your order must also meet the applicable customer eligibility and monthly usage limits. How Often Can You Use the $29 PCB Assembly Offer? The $29 PCB assembly promotion has a monthly usage limit based on customer status. New customers: Eligible new customers can use the offer once per month. Returning customers: Eligible returning customers can use the offer up to twice per month. If you submit multiple orders at the same time, only one eligible order can receive the $29 promotional price. The remaining orders will be charged at their applicable rates. Please note that each order must meet all the technical requirements to qualify for the promotion. The monthly usage limit does not mean that every order you submit will receive the special price. How to Get $29 PCB Assembly on PCBWay Follow these steps to get started. Step 1: Prepare your PCB design files Prepare your Gerber files, Bill of Materials (BOM), and pick-and-place file, as applicable to your project. Step 2: Check your project requirements Confirm that your project uses rigid PCBs, that all components will be supplied by PCBWay, and that your assembly quantity and component counts are within the specified limits. Step 3: Submit your assembly order Visit the PCBWay PCB Assembly Service page and submit your PCB assembly files and requirements. Step 4: Confirm your eligibility Check your eligibility for the promotion and make sure you have not exceeded the applicable usage limit. The final price is subject to order review and confirmation. Frequently Asked Questions -Can I use the $29 PCB assembly offer for flex PCBs or rigid-flex PCBs? No. The promotion is available for rigid PCBs only. Flex PCBs and rigid-flex PCBs are excluded. -Can I supply my own components? No. All components must be supplied by PCBWay to qualify for this offer. -Can I order more than 20 boards? No. The maximum eligible assembly quantity is 20 boards per order. -How many components can my PCB have? Each board can have no more than 200 components, and the total component quantity across the order cannot exceed 600. -Is there a limit on component types? Yes. The project can include no more than 100 different component types. -Are through-hole components allowed? Projects with through-hole components may qualify, provided that the total number of through-hole solder joints does not exceed 100 and all other requirements are met. -Can I apply the $29 price to multiple orders submitted at once? No. Only one eligible order can receive the promotional price when multiple orders are submitted together. -Can I use the offer again next month? The promotion may be available again according to the applicable monthly usage limit. Please check your eligibility before placing another order. -Does the $29 price cover my entire PCB project? The $29 offer is a special PCB assembly price, not necessarily the total cost of your project. PCB fabrication, components, shipping, and other applicable charges may be quoted separately. PCBWay's $29 PCB assembly offer is designed to make simple PCB prototypes more affordable. Check the eligibility requirements before ordering to ensure your project meets the technical limits and promotion rules. Ready to get started?
